signals._doc: v3: signal tooltips — no literal UI text lives in domain code (Chart Engine v3)

pas.hint: PAS · EFT={eft}% (current={current} · future={future}) · direction={direction} · strength={count} · RMI={rmi} · IM={im} · GAP={gap} · PRF={prf}

gap.hint: GAP = policy rate − inflation = {value}% — positive = positive real rate

prf.hint: PRF = policy reliability = {value}% (target fit 60% + rate stability 40%)

real.hint: Real = policy rate − headline CPI = {policy} − {cpi} = {real}pp · bands: below {strongNeg} ultra-accommodative · below {mildNeg} accommodative · within ±{neutral} neutral · above {neutral} real tightening
real.noData: Real — policy rate or headline CPI is not available for this country ⇒ no value is shown.
real.invalid: Real — invalid value in the source data.

yld.hint: Yld = 10-year yield = {value}% ({date}) · bands: below {low} easy · below {neutralHigh} neutral · below {tightHigh} tight · {tightHigh}+ = financial stress
yld.noDataStale: Yld — latest available point is {date} (older than {maxAge} months ⇒ not drawn).
yld.noDataSource: Yld — no 10-year yield series exists for this country (FRED/OECD do not publish it).

gas.hint: GAS · GFT={gft} (level {level}) · current={current} · future={future} · direction={direction} · strength={count} · pressure={pressure} · GMI={gmi} · OGI={ogi}% · σ={sigma} · stability={stability}% · GAPg={gapg}pp · source: YoY={yoySrc} · QoQ={qoqSrc} · {sources}
gas.noData: GAS — not enough growth data for this country. Source: YoY={yoySrc} · QoQ={qoqSrc} · {sources}

gmi.hint: GMI = Δ1+Δ3 GDP YoY plus Δ1+Δ3 GDP QoQ = {value} · source: YoY={yoySrc} · QoQ={qoqSrc} · {sources}

ogi.hint: OGI = deviation of the GDP level from its 4-quarter trend = {value}% (documented proxy for potential GDP)

gsi.hint: GSI = σ of YoY growth steps = {sigma} · normalised stability = {stability}% (reference σ {sigmaRef})

pmi.noData: PMI — no provider publishes PMI in the pipeline (IND_PROD is the only industry proxy).

now.noData: NOW — no nowcast source in the pipeline; no approximation is fabricated.

gapg.hint: GAPg = GDP YoY − average of the previous 4 quarters = {value}pp · positive = growth above trend

fas.hint: FAS · FCI={fci} (level {level}) · Hardness={hardness}% · direction={direction} · strength={count} · ΔY10+ΔCredit={deltaSum} · components: y10={y10} · credit={credit} · vol={vol} · equity={equity} · dxy={dxy} · liquidity={liquidity} · available: {used}
fas.noData: FAS — no financial-conditions input was available/fresh ⇒ neutral badge.

financial.sourceNote: Country 10Y: {country} ({y10Date}) · available={y10Available} · Credit/DXY/Equity/Liquidity/Vol are global benchmarks (FRED/US)

y10.hint: Y10 = 10-year yield of {country} = {value} · Δ1={delta} pp ⇒ rising = tighter
y10.noData: Y10 — the 10-year yield is not available for this country.

credit.hint: Credit = IG credit spread (OAS) = {value} · Δ1={delta} ⇒ widening = tighter · global (US)
credit.noData: Credit — the credit spread is not available.

dxy.hint: DXY = broad effective dollar index = {value} · Δ1={delta}% ⇒ stronger dollar = tighter · global
dxy.noData: DXY — the dollar index is not available.

equity.hint: Equity = equity index (S&P 500) = {value} · Δ1={delta}% ⇒ rising = easier · global
equity.noData: Equity — the equity index is not available.

liquidity.hint: Liquidity = M2 YoY growth = {yoy} · Δ3M={delta3} · level={level} · global proxy (US M2)
liquidity.noData: Liquidity — the M2 series is not available.

vol.hint: Vol = implied volatility (VIX) = {value} · Δ1={delta}% ⇒ rising = tighter · global
vol.noData: Vol — market volatility (VIX) is not available.

cc.title: Control Center
cc.noParams: This item has no numeric parameters

desc.indicators: Averages, volatility and momentum on closed candles
desc.priceaction: Swings, structure breaks and fair-value gaps
desc.moneyflow: Cumulative delta, funding and open interest
desc.ai: Analytical summary of this chart's data

volume.label: VS
volume.hint: Volume spike: the candle volume deviates from the previous {window}-candle average by |z| ≥ {z} standard deviations.

atr.label: AB
atr.hint: ATR breakout: the range exceeds {k}× ATR of the previous candle (volatility-based break, not a market-structure BOS).

patterns.label: PAT
patterns.hint: Candle patterns: doji (body ≤ {dojiRatio}×range), hammer / shooting star (shadow ≥ {shadowRatio}×body) and bullish/bearish engulfing. A pattern hint only — not an entry signal.

divergence.label: DIV
divergence.hint: Divergence between price pivots and the oscillator (pivot width {pivot}, max {lookback} bars apart), confirmed only after {pivot} bars — never used before confirmation.

structure.label: STR
structure.hint: Market structure: a close beyond the last CONFIRMED swing (width {pivot}, clusters < {minBars} bars merged). Same-direction break = BOS (continuation), opposite = CHoCH (character change). Confirmed on the breaking candle's close.

fvg.label: FVG
fvg.hint: Fair value gap: a three-candle imbalance (low[i] > high[i−2] or high[i] < low[i−2]) with the untraded zone marked. Filled zones are flagged, not deleted.

btc.label: BTC
btc.hint: Latest close and the change against the previous candle (last price on the New-York-closed axis).

tf.label: TF
tf.hint: Timeframe requested from the historical service (lowercase engine key).

venue.label: VENUE
venue.hint: Exchange filter; "All venues" sends no exchange parameter and aggregates every venue.

cross.label: CX
cross.hint: Last crossing of EMA{fast} over/under SMA{slow}; the number is how many candles ago it happened.

gap.label: GAP
gap.hint: Missing-candle gaps in the returned window: {coverage}% coverage, largest gap {max} bars. Gaps are only reported — no synthetic candles are created.

vol.label: VOL
vol.hint: Last candle volume as a z-score against the 20-candle average; |z| ≥ 2 is highlighted.

spread.label: SPRD
spread.hint: Distance between EMA{fast} and SMA{slow} in percent of the slow average.

warn.label: WARN
warn.hint: Data-health warning badge (double width): stale feed, gaps, low coverage or a service error.
